description:
If you quit, your future gets predictable.

You already know how that story ends.

But if you keep going, if you stay in the game, if you keep deciding who you’re becoming… everything stays possible.

That’s the part most people miss.

The moment you refuse to quit, you give yourself a chance to become someone new.

So why not go all in?

What’s the best that could happen?
transcript: If you quit, it's really easy to predict your future. How's that feel? But if you don't quit, if you go for it with no proof, you can't quantify it, people are gonna call you crazy. Your friends are gonna look at you sideways. But you'll have the opportunity to play in the game and stop sitting on the sidelines. And you might for a while and you might have to pay your success tax and you might have to go through seven failures nine failures twelve failures you might be sleepless at night wondering why the heck you're doing it but on the other side of that you get to see who you're meant to be who god designed you to be and tap into your full potential and there's nothing better. Has life been easy for me as an entrepreneur starting with nothing with self-doubt? Heck no. But is life easy for anyone? You're gonna deal with crap. You're gonna deal with disappointment. You're gonna have things go sideways. If you are, you might as well go all in on the person you wanna be, the love that you want, the parent you want, the freedom you want, the control you want, the money you want, the business you want, the control you want, the money you want, the business you want. So this is my call to you today. Don't quit.
